map.怎么找限量物？: How do I find the limiting reactant?
map.各反应物摩尔÷自身系数，最小者限量。: Moles of each reactant ÷ its own coefficient; the smallest is limiting.
map.过量物算产量吗？: Is the excess reactant counted in the yield?
map.不计，产量由限量物决定；过量部分剩余。: No; yield is set by the limiting reactant and the excess simply remains.
map.系数一定要整数配平吗？: Must coefficients be whole numbers from balancing?
map.用最简整数比即可，关键是摩尔比。: The simplest integer ratio is fine; what matters is the mole ratio.
